display.title: Shiva Asar B'Tammuz: Asking Hashem 'Until When?'
display.summary_short: On Shiva Asar B'Tammuz, Uncle Yossi explains how the walls of Yerushalayim were breached, why the Three Weeks are sad, and how our Torah and mitzvos can bring the Geulah.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show broadcast on Shiva Asar B'Tammuz, the first day of the Three Weeks (Bein HaMetzarim). Uncle Yossi reminds children of Asarah B'Teves, when the enemy surrounded Yerushalayim and for two years let no food or water in. That siege led to the seventeenth of Tammuz, when the enemy broke through the city walls, and then to the saddest day in Jewish history, Tisha B'Av, when the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed. It is important to know these dates, because each year on them we fast and cry out to Hashem, 'Ad masai, until when?' But Hashem is also asking 'until when?', waiting for every Jew to be ready to welcome Moshiach. So we must learn more Torah, do more mitzvos and encourage our relatives and friends to do the same, and then Hashem will answer our cry, end the golus and rebuild the third Beis HaMikdash.
display.lesson: Hashem is waiting for us too: learn more Torah, do more mitzvos and help others do the same to end the golus.
